headline: NDS deal and pricing drive growth, FY targets confirmed

kpis.label: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing ops (non-GAAP)

summary_short: Net sales rose 20.6% y/y to $1,001M, boosted by the NDS acquisition and 9.2% organic growth, while Adjusted EBITDA increased 28.8% to $358.3M as margin expanded 230bps to 35.8%.
summary_long: Growth was broad-based: NDS contributed $94.7M of stormwater net sales, organic sales grew 9.2%, and pricing actions ahead of cost inflation pulled forward some Q2 demand. Gross profit rose 23.5% on NDS, volume, and favorable price/cost, partly offset by higher transportation costs; SG&A rose 25.8% mainly from NDS. Net income attributable to ADS rose 17.1% to $169M and diluted EPS to $2.19, while adjusted diluted EPS from continuing operations rose 27.7% to $2.49. Operating cash flow fell 5.3% and free cash flow fell 8.6% on working-capital timing. ADS repurchased $228.5M of stock, pushing net debt up $54.5M q/q and cash down 74.6% y/y to $162M. Fiscal 2027 targets (net sales $3.35-3.55B, Adjusted EBITDA $1.0-1.05B, capex ~$200M) were confirmed unchanged.

Fiscal-period-label note: the company's own release labels this quarter 'first quarter fiscal 2027' (Advanced Drainage Systems' fiscal year runs April-March), while our shard/period convention labels the identical June-30-2026 quarter 'FY2026 Q2' — same reported quarter, differing fiscal-year-numbering conventions, no data conflict. Net income reconciliation: the shard's net_income_usd_m ($168.5M, SEC tag NetIncomeLoss, net of $2.4M noncontrolling interest and a $5.7M net loss from discontinued operations) is 'net income attributable to ADS'; the release's headlined '+22.5% to $176.6M' figure is 'net income from continuing operations' before discontinued-ops loss and NCI — both are real GAAP subtotals from the same income statement. Diluted EPS $2.19 (all operations) likewise differs from the release's headlined $2.26 (continuing-operations-only diluted EPS) for the same reason. Guidance: release states the company 'confirmed its financial targets for fiscal 2027' (net sales, Adjusted EBITDA, capex) with no prior range restated for comparison, supporting guidance.move='held'.

drivers.explanation: CEO cites pull-forward of sales ahead of price actions, strong organic growth, and a meaningful NDS contribution; company stays cautious on demand despite confirming FY2027 targets.
Driven by NDS ($94.7M of stormwater sales), 9.2% organic growth, and sales pulled forward ahead of price increases; domestic construction sales rose 20% across all categories.
Primarily driven by the NDS acquisition, volume growth, and favorable price/cost and manufacturing costs, partly offset by higher transportation costs.
Favorable volume from non-residential strength and pre-price-action purchases, combined with disciplined price/cost management, expanded margin in both segments.
Release discloses $228.5M of share repurchases in the quarter alongside a $54.5M q/q rise in net debt and the cash decline; no explicit causal statement links them.
